description.narrative: The purpose of the grant is to build local capacity to develop National Health Accounts in Mongolia and to support the Governments efforts to improve the performance of the health system. The activities to be supported under the Capacity Building for Public Expenditure Management in the Health Sector Project include: Developing a framework for NHA: Three in-country workshops will be conducted with relevant health sector stakeholders, data producers and data users at central and aimag levels to develop a framework for NHA for Mongolia. This will include identifying data sources, areas of primary data collection and surveys. Training: Training of local staff involved in development of National Health Accounts system will be organized through series of in-country seminars during the process of NHA development. This training will provide local staff necessary skills to develop NHA in their regions and to use the outcomes to ensure strategic use of health resources and to monitor future health spending. Key members the National Steering Committee and the National Health Accounts Working Group will be sent on study tours to two countries where the NHA exercise has been successful. Two key members will also attend the course on National Health Accounts organized by Harvard School of Public Health in Vermont, USA. Review and collection of data on health expenditures at both central and aimag level: This process will involve an in-depth review of current public health expenditures, health insurance fund and private health expenditures. Existing sources of data will be reviewed and analyzed. The Household Income and Expenditure Survey 2002 (being conducted with assistance from the World Bank) will be analyzed to estimate private out of pocket payments for health care services. Where data gaps are identified, surveys will be conducted to collect missing and required data for estimations. Technical support will be provided in design and fielding of surveys to collect data where there are information gaps, which cannot be filled in any other way, and carry out the related data analysis. Development of the National Health Accounts System at both central and aimag level: Based on the review and the NHA framework, the first National Health Accounts of Mongolia will be developed. Guidelines with recommendations for annual maintenance and compilation of NHA including use of data for policy reform and implementation will be developed. This exercise will be conducted with the involvement of MOFE, the State Social Insurance General Office and the MOH at central and aimag levels whereby each level of government will develop its own health accounts. .Production and dissemination of the NHA report: This will include the preparation and printing of a report giving final NHA estimates. Three in-country workshops will be held, one in Ulaanbataar, and two in aimags to disseminate the results of the NHA report among parliamentarians and policy makers.
